steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Luckily I did some warm up back in Chernobog. But really, I didn't even break a sweat handling you guys.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You! You Rhodes Islander, you're a disgrace to all Infected. How could you turn on your own like this just to help Lungmen?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: So you'll hand us over to them, as if that keeps your hands clean? Bullshit! How do you live with yourself?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You ate two punches, cracked your skull on the pavement and you've still got the energy to talk trash? Not bad.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But you've got it all wrong.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Mmf!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Having trouble breathing? Feel like your lungs are on fire?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ack... Guh...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It starts in your sinuses, then crawls down your windpipe, until it finally finds a home there in your diaphragm. All I have to do is wiggle my little finger and...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: A stream of superheated air will shoot into your body, expand, ignite your organs, and erupt out of your pores.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The funny thing is, Lungmen might let you live. But me and my little finger...?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aah! Gaaah...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Won't leave any of you breathing.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Nooooo! L-let me go! Please!!!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Fine. I'll be merciful.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Officer! Over here. You take care of them.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And one more thing, my new Ursus buddy. You think next time you could actually make me break a sweat?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, they made it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, over here!

options: You're certainly making a lot of noise.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah. That was nothing.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How about next time I show you how to snap an arm 90 degrees without breaking the bone?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, what's with that face...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How long have you been at Rhodes Island? You're acting like you've never seen a fight before.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Compared to them, I'm a regular softie.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But of course. You think I'm the type to play it low-key?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If I can put the fear of Blaze into them, who knows how many others might just give up.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I have to play it up to make all my hard work worth something.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's not steer the Doctor astray...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Bunny!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't just scoop me up like a toy!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But you're just so soft...! Hey! Stop struggling! Just let it happen. I promise I won't bite!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze... Stop... Can't... Breathe!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've only been apart for an hour! What's with you! Get serious!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I take it back. You're not cute.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's enough...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Woah, hey, I was just playing! Get out of my head! I can't take you screwing around with my emotions again!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's here with you?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Hello, I'm...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I know who you are.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Talk to my fellow Infected like that again and I'll tear out your throat myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, Amiya.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But that's the way it is. And she deserves a warning.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm out. Rendezvous at the next waypoint.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: GreyThroat, Blaze may have misunderstood you.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It's fine. I really did say those things.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She shouldn't be dredging up your past to attack the person you are today.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Who knows? Have I really changed? Even I don't know.

options: You'll need to do something to find it out then.
Can we really have you running ops right now?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm here because I wanted to do something. No matter what that Blaze says.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Right... She's not Infected, so GreyThroat might not grasp the reality of Rhodes Island's current situation.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (This operation could force her to decide once and for all... if she's going to stay or leave.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (But she's gotten used to taking orders, and doesn't speak up much. Sometimes she does surprise, though...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (There's no malice in her heart. She just needs a chance to find herself.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Still, she's strong and reliable. You can trust her, Doctor. And even if we can't help her, I know she can help you.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... where did Gavial go?

options: Got too excited and went to crack some skulls?
Probably went to do frivolous collateral damage.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She can't do that!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait a minute, who taught you to think of her like that, Doctor? I mean, it's kind of true, but still...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We can't afford to make mistakes here. Hurry to the next waypoint and try to signal her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if she's operating according to plan, there'll be trouble if no one's watching her...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've got elite operators acting as squad leaders. They'll report in. Don't worry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We stand at a crucial point in this joint operation. This is the decisive battle for Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She has her own mission to command.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, as Chief of the Special Inspection Unit, will be deploying the best the L. G. D. has to offer against Reunion in service of our joint plan.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At the same time, she has to herd Reunion's main force to the target location, all while keeping any of their smaller teams from slipping into the slums.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And we, Rhodes Island, will keep moving through the waypoints on our patrol route, mopping up Reunion's squads along the way, pushing them to give up the fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Finally, we'll reach the target location at the slums and, together with the L. G. D., we'll deliver the decisive blow to Reunion's main force.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Considering the scale, there's relatively little Rhodes Island can do. But we'll execute the plan to the best of our abilities.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As for the issues that have come up in the course of our cooperation with the L. G. D.... Dr. {@nickname}, I promise to answer all our people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Doctor, there is something only you can do.

options: Should I be taking this more seriously?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Heh, good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's not the kind of thing you'll have to put so much effort into.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now's not the time to clam up!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you waiting for me to say more?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You could at least tell me what you're thinking, Doctor...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, that's okay!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't the kind of thing you need to be so solemn about.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm going to call up Blaze and have her look after you. And for the little while until we meet up again, I need you to look after her too.

options: Me look after her? Have you seen me?
I can protect an elite operator? News to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh... I'm not talking about like in battle! I mean look after her psychology.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You know Rhodes Island has to fight the Infected sometimes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Especially right now. Our cooperation with Lungmen has led to some friction.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze is one of the elite operators we rely on for survival, yes, but her psychological state has an impact on her performance.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It is because she is so resolutely committed to our mission that her encounters with the Infected have the potential to influence her emotions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Go on, Doctor. Treat it as an opportunity to learn what makes her tick.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Show your appreciation for her. Thank her for saving you back there. She'll eat it up!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I believe in you, Doctor! Go get 'em!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Their main force is engaging our other teams!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We will reach the target location ahead of Reunion and join the formation!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tell them we need to eliminate all Reunion elements that have not joined up with their main force first.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Right. Got it!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Do what Superintendent Ch'en just said! Over and out!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: How long has it been since we fought together like this?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I wouldn't say we're 'fighting together' now. It's more like we're 'co-belligerents.' How did you get back here anyway?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I've got my own motor pool, of course. How else do you think I saved Rhodes Island? Now what's got your panties in a twist? I can tell you're upset.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hm. Let me think.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You need to think about it! Look at you looking for reasons to be mad...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Oh, right. You went behind my back to save Rhodes Island. You could have told me in private.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Was that embarrassing for you? Or you just don't like being kept in the dark?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Both.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wowee... since when are you so direct? My old Officer Ch'en would talk herself in circles for hours...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Eyes forward!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: L. G. D. defender squad, shields up! Play it just like we have a million times before. And never forget, your brothers and sisters are right behind you! Stand firm!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hold!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Crossbows, nock!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They blocked this road too? Uh oh... there's nowhere to go! We're trapped!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Relax, we can break them! With me!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hold!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Guards, ready!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Overrun them!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ——Now!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Crossbows, first volley, fire!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Pikes up!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't let a single one of them out of our city!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Are you on site?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yes, that's right.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I know. But the L. G. D. has their job to do and you have yours. Don't forget your role in all this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Indeed. Lin Kojui is quite opposed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But this matter is beyond him!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've heard all the opinions from all the stakeholders. But there is no wiggle room here. I do what must be done.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Kojui's daughter will reach out to you. In the next three weeks, you are not to contact me. Everything goes to her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I leave it to you. Don't worry. I am watching you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...There's no need for that. The past is the past. And it stays in the past.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Right. To the peaceful and stable future of Lungmen.
Wei, old boy, we're brothers, of a sort, aren't we...?
So I'm asking you, for the sake of my daughter and her mother...
Honestly, should I even have to ask? Would you really refuse to help your own sister?
I've already decided on a name for my daughter. We'll call her...
...Talulah.
Don't take it to heart. I understand.
It's all very clear to me.
